module: GE extension `core_quickAccess`: the game's radial menu (quick menu). It keeps a menu tree (paths like '/root/sandbox/other/'), assembles it on opening (static entries, generators, entries requested from the player vehicle), positions it on the 8 slots of the circle then sends it to the UI (guihooks 'radialMenuUpdated', UI route 'radial'). It slows down time while the menu is open, remembers recent actions and the dynamic slot configuration (settings/radialRecentActions.json and settings/radialDynamicSlotSettings.json). A mod adds its own buttons with core_quickAccess.addEntry, preferably in the onRegisterQuickAccessMenus hook.
notes: HOW A MOD ADDS ENTRIES: (1) define the onRegisterQuickAccessMenus hook in your GE extension (called by registerDefaultMenus at the first onInit of core_quickAccess, after the base menus) and call core_quickAccess.addEntry(...) in it. (2) If the extension is loaded later, call addEntry directly or listen to onQuickAccessLoaded (emitted at quickAccess's onExtensionLoaded). Entries added after the first onInit are only taken into account the next time the menu is opened (the tree is copied on every show). core_quickAccess.registerMenu is deprecated: it just logs an error.

Arguments of addEntry: `level` (menu path; default '/root/sandbox/general/'; if it does not start with '/root/' it is prefixed with '/root/sandbox'; a trailing '/' is added); either `generator = function(entries)` which inserts button tables into `entries`, or directly `title` + (`onSelect` or `goto`). If `uniqueID` is given, an existing entry of the same level with the same uniqueID is replaced. The argument is copied by deepcopy: do not put shared objects whose identity matters in it, but functions are kept.

Button fields (read in the code): title (translation key or text), desc, icon (icon name; old names listed in ui/assets/iconMappings/iconTags.json are replaced with a warning), goto (submenu path: the button becomes a folder), onSelect/onSecondarySelect/onTertiarySelect(item) for actions 1, 2, 3, onDeselect/onSecondaryDeselect/onTertiaryDeselect(item) on release, startSlot/endSlot (position), priority, uniqueID, enabled (default true), categoryOrder (for categories), ignoreAsRecentAction, ignoreForCheckingIfMenuIsEmpty, contextAction (function, called by contextAction()), dynamicSlot = {id=...}.

Return value of onSelect/onDeselect: a table whose 1st element is the command: {'hide'} closes the menu, {'reload'} rebuilds it, {'goto', path} opens a submenu, {'back'} goes back, {'hideMeOnly'} closes, {'temporaryHide'} hides the UI while restoring normal time (to aim/click), {'temporaryUnhide'} shows it again and slows down again, {'hideAndIgnoreSlowmotion'} closes without restoring time. Any other return (nil included) is logged as an 'invalid item result args' error: always return a table.

Circle slots (maxSlotAmount = 8): 1 left, 3 top, 5 right, 7 bottom, 2/4/6/8 diagonals. startSlot alone = 1 slot; startSlot + endSlot = wide button covering the range. Two buttons at overlapping slots: the second loses its position with a warning. Buttons without a slot are distributed in the gaps. More buttons than room are still possible (they shrink).

The valid root levels are '/root/playerVehicle/' (vehicle actions, default '/root/playerVehicle/general/') and '/root/sandbox/' (default '/root/sandbox/quick/'; replaced by '/root/sandbox/career/' in career and '/root/sandbox/mission/' during a challenge). Base sandbox categories: other, funStuff, repair, quick, mission, career, vehicles, traffic, ai. Missing goto buttons between levels are added automatically (title via toNiceName, icon 'material_traffic'). An empty level (no useful button) is removed from the tree except protected paths.

Vehicle-side entries (vehicle VM) go through vehicle/extensions core_quickAccess.requestItems: on opening the GE sends requestItems(level) to the player vehicle and waits up to 4 GFX frames (vehicleWaitFrames). After that, onUpdate displays the menu anyway with a 'vehicle didn't respond in time' error. The vehicle calls back vehicleItemsCallback(objID, level, tree). Item selections coming from the vehicle are sent back to its extension via selectItem.

Dynamic slots (dynamicSlot): slots configurable by the player (ids like root_up, sandbox_left, vehicle_down, funstuff_left...) with a mode 'recentActions', 'uniqueAction' (specific action identified by level + uniqueID) or 'empty'. Only actions with a uniqueID and without ignoreAsRecentAction are remembered as recent actions (10 max for 'all'). Giving a stable uniqueID therefore lets a mod appear in these slots.

Probable bug: in _assembleMenuComplete, `if not item.title then item.title = toNiceName(str) end` uses a variable `str` that is never defined (nil), so a category without a title would cause an error in toNiceName (inferred from code).
Inconsistency: at load, `recentActions` only contains the 'all' category, but clearRecentActions() replaces it with a table with playerVehicle, sandbox, other and all.

In selectItem and contextAction, if the item does not exist, the error is logged but the code continues: selectItem calls itemAction(nil) (ignored) but contextAction reads m.contextAction on nil and crashes.

Dependencies loaded beforehand: core_vehicleTriggers, core_funstuff. The module also uses the global ui_imgui (im) and reads settings/radialFavorites.json as a name (variable safeFile not used in the parts read).

setSlowMoFactor.desc: Sets the time factor (simTimeAuthority) applied while the radial menu is open. 0.01 by default.

resetSlowMoFactor.desc: Resets the slow-motion factor to its original value (0.01).

addEntry.desc: Adds (or replaces, if same uniqueID at the same level) an entry in the radial menu tree. See notes for all fields. Returns false only if `level` is not a string; a warning is logged if the entry has neither generator, nor title with onSelect/goto, but the entry is still added.

_args.desc: { level, generator | (title, onSelect|goto, icon, desc, uniqueID, priority, startSlot, endSlot, ... ) }

returns.desc: true if added, false if level is invalid.

registerMenu.desc: Deprecated: logs an error asking to use addEntry, does nothing else.

isEnabled.desc: Indicates whether the radial menu is currently displayed.

returns.desc: true if the radial UI is visible.

setEnabled.desc: Opens or closes the menu. Opening only happens if the UI state is 'play' or unknown, or if the menu is already visible, or if force. Emits the onQuickAccessOpened(level) hook. Closing is ignored during a route handoff.

enabled.desc: true to open, false to close.

force.desc: Opens even if another screen is active.

toggle.desc: Opens the menu if it is closed, closes it otherwise. Used by the 'toggleRadialMenuMulti' action.

gotoLevel.desc: Goes to another menu level, pushing the current level onto the history (for back).

back.desc: Goes back to the previous level (history), or to the parent level according to the path if the history is empty.

returns.desc: true if the level changed, false otherwise (menu closed or already at the top).

reload.desc: Rebuilds and redisplays the current level (if the menu is open).

selectItem.desc: Called by the UI when the player presses/releases a button: runs the action of the item with index id in the current menu.

id.desc: Index (1-based) of the item in currentMenuItems.

buttonDown.desc: true on press, false on release.

contextAction.desc: Called by the UI for a button's context action (e.g. opening the configuration of a dynamic slot).

adjustCruiseSpeed.desc: UI callback: asks the player vehicle to adjust the cruise control speed (vehicle-side extension).

direction.desc: Positive = increase, negative = decrease; 0 or non-number ignored.

getUiData.desc: Returns the data sent to the menu UI: canGoBack, items, categories, pathBeforeCategory, selectedCategory, backButtonIndex, currentLevel, breadcrumbs, menuIcon, hasLRShoulderButtons, tutorialHighlightTargets.

returns.desc: uiData, nil before the first opening.

setTutorialHighlightTargets.desc: Sets the list of identifiers to highlight in the menu (tutorial). Non-string, empty or duplicate values are filtered out. Refreshes the UI if visible.

getMostRecentAvailableActions.desc: Returns the recent actions (of the given category) still available in the menu, excluding those already assigned to a 'uniqueAction' slot, limited to `limit`.

dynamicItems.desc: dynamicSlot-type items of the current level.

returns.desc: Records { uniqueID, level, title, timestamp, icon }.

clearRecentActions.desc: Clears the recent actions history and emits onQuickAccessClearRecentActions.

resetDynamicSlotSettings.desc: Restores the default configuration of the dynamic slots, saves it and emits onQuickAccessResetDynamicSlotSettings.

openDynamicSlotConfigurator.desc: Opens the configuration screen of a dynamic slot (guihooks 'OpenDynamicSlotConfigurator', hook onOpenDynamicSlotConfigurator).

getDynamicSlotConfigurationData.desc: Prepares for the UI the configuration data of the slot opened by openDynamicSlotConfigurator (menu tree and current setting). Crashes if no slot has been opened.

setDynamicSlotConfiguration.desc: Saves the player's choice for a dynamic slot (modes uniqueAction, recentActions or empty), emits the hooks onQuickAccessSetUniqueAction / SetRecentActions / SetEmpty then onQuickAccessSetDynamicSlotConfiguration, saves and reloads the menu.

data.desc: { mode, uniqueID, level } or { mode, category }.

toNiceName.desc: Turns an identifier into a readable name: '_' becomes a space, a space before each capital stuck to a lowercase letter, first letter of each word capitalized, the rest lowercase.

beginRouteHandoff.desc: Marks the transition from the radial menu to a child screen (e.g. radial.mirrors) without a real close, and temporarily hides the UI.

endRouteHandoff.desc: Ends the handoff and shows the menu again (time slowed down again).

isRouteHandoffActive.desc: Indicates whether a handoff to a child screen is in progress.

finishRouteHandoffExit.desc: Cleans up the radial state when a child screen returns directly to the game, without navigating back to 'play'.

getMovedRadialLastTimeMs.desc: Returns the time (system ms) of the last call to moved().

moved.desc: Records the current time as the last movement of the radial cursor (called by the UI).

getVehicleName.desc: Builds a readable vehicle name: brand, name and configuration from core_vehicles.getModel; otherwise the JBeam name.

veh.desc: Vehicle object; nil returns the translation key 'ui.radialmenu2.noVehicle'.

tryAction.desc: Runs an action tied to the menu keys among: toggleBigMap, toggleRadialMenuMulti, recoverVehicle, resetVehicle, activateStarterMotor. Ignored if core_input_actionFilter blocks it; an unknown action is logged as an error.

vehicleItemsCallback.desc: Callback from the player vehicle with its menu entries for a level: stores them and displays the menu.

vehicleItemSelectCallback.desc: Callback from the vehicle after an item action has run: processes the returned command ({'hide'}, {'goto', ...}, etc.).

args.desc: Command to run, same format as the return of onSelect.

onInit.desc: Extension initialization hook: on the first call registers the default menus (then emits onRegisterQuickAccessMenus), then closes the menu.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: On load: emits onQuickAccessLoaded, reads the recent actions and the dynamic slot settings.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: On unload: saves the recent actions.

onExit.desc: When the game closes: saves the recent actions.

onClientEndMission.desc: At the end of a level: saves the recent actions.

onVehicleSpawned.desc: When a vehicle spawns: saves the recent actions.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: When the player vehicle changes: reloads the menu if it is open.

onUpdate.desc: Called every GFX frame: handles the wait delay for the vehicle's entries (4 frames) and forces assembly if the vehicle does not respond.

onUiChangedState.desc: When the UI route changes: if another route takes over while the menu is visible, closes it without navigating; also ends a handoff when the state becomes 'play'.

onSerialize.desc: Before a Lua reload: closes the menu and saves recent actions and dynamic slots.

onBeforeBigMapActivated.desc: Before the big map opens: closes the radial menu.
